high_level_description: The image features a gradient background that transitions from a light beige at the top to a deep red at the bottom. The text is prominently displayed in white, centered on the image, making it stand out against the colorful backdrop. The text reads: "I've heard that the roads on the Yamuna Expressway have provisions to land jets, in times of need. Art and its effects that I carry through, make Chennai look similar." The mood conveyed by the image is somewhat reflective and contemplative.
